analysis.d: THE 2014 BOOK CARRIES THE HETERONYM ON ITS COVER. A bookshop.org record from OCTOBER 2014 credits "Johannes Sigil and Lee Sharks" — the co-authorship in the commercial record twelve years before the archive theorised it.
analysis.reading:
THE HETERONYM IS IN THE COMMERCIAL BIBLIOGRAPHIC RECORD, DATED 2014. Card 6 is bookshop.org for Pearl and Other Poems, "a book by JOHANNES SIGIL AND LEE SHARKS", published by New Human Press, 15 October 2014 — a retail listing that carries the heteronymic co-authorship as ordinary bibliographic fact, more than a decade before the Dodecad was specified. The blurb reads: "Pearl is an important poem, and Lee Sharks is destined to stick around for awhile."

Card 5 is the archive documenting the composition layer’s own constraints: "AI safety filters flag 'absolute declarations' as potentially harmful unless contextualized within safe genres. This document provides that contextualization." A deposit written to satisfy a filter, retrieved by the system whose filter it addresses.
